findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_products, calculate_quote, track_order, get_store_faq · Private data: get_products, calculate_quote, create_checkout_link, track_order, get_store_faq · Public sink: create_checkout_link · Destructive: get_products, calculate_quote, create_checkout_link, track_order, get_store_faq.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_products, calculate_quote, track_order, get_store_faq · Private data: get_products, calculate_quote, create_checkout_link, track_order, get_store_faq · Public sink: create_checkout_link · Destructive: get_products, calculate_quote, create_checkout_link, track_order, get_store_faq

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
